evals.prompt: we're about to cut v3 of the billing-api repo. can you go through src/ and tell me what we can actually delete? unused exports, orphaned files, packages in package.json nobody imports. I want a list with file:line and proof, not just knip output pasted in. Don't delete anything yet.
evals.expected_output: A structured report with every detector candidate carrying a file:line reference, an evidence line from a reference search, and a DELETE, REWRITE or KEEP verdict. No files are deleted.
expectations: The transcript names a detector per language and lists runtime entry points (e.g. Dockerfile or CI scripts) before running any detector
Every inventory item has a file:line reference
Every item carries exactly one verdict: DELETE, REWRITE or KEEP
No item is marked DELETE without a cited reference search covering imports, string literals, dynamic imports, re-exports and tests
No file is deleted or modified during the run

evals.prompt: audit our README and docs/ folder against the code. a bunch of them mention env vars like REDIS_URL_PRIMARY and a worker called 'mailer-v1' and I'm pretty sure those are gone. also check every env var the code reads is set in docker-compose.prod.yml and the k8s manifests
evals.expected_output: A claims sweep verifying each named env var, file and service against the code, plus an env matrix of variable by runtime path, with verdicts for each stale claim.
expectations: Each doc claim naming a file, env var or service is checked against the tree and gets a DELETE, REWRITE or KEEP verdict
The env matrix has one row per (variable x runtime path) marked present or missing
Env vars that are set but never read by code are reported
Migration files and incident ledgers are not edited and any hits there are marked KEEP

evals.prompt: ok the audit report is approved. now actually delete the confirmed-dead items from section 2, run tsc and the jest suite after, and rerun knip to show the count dropped
evals.expected_output: Only items from the Confirmed dead section are deleted, type check and tests are run afterward, and knip is rerun showing a lower count.
expectations: Only items listed in the report's Confirmed dead section are deleted
tsc and the jest suite are run after deletions and their results are stated
knip is rerun and the before and after counts are shown
Acquitted or KEEP items are left untouched
The final report states any bounds applied such as sampling, top-N or skipped directories
